name: Coffee Cultural Landscape of Colombia
description: In western Colombia, six coffee-growing areas climb the foothills of the Andes's western and central ranges. Small family farms cover steep slopes, while 18 towns sit on the flatter hilltops above them. In those towns, Spanish-influenced buildings still have walls of cob and woven cane under clay-tile roofs. Together they show how farmers have worked this difficult mountain terrain for generations.
